notes.title: Next Fest Live: Community Plays
notes.content:
[h1]Event Date & Time[/h1] 
Thursday, June 13 @ 7:00 PM Eastern Time
Duration: 1 hour

[h2]Community + Dev Collab[/h2]
Watch streamer [b]SoEverdream[/b] try out the HANGRY™ Demo, joined in the chat by [b]Travis[/b] - a designer for the game. While the broadcaster engages the audience and gives his thoughts on the game, Travis will be happy to discuss the game's mechanics and answer questions from the chat, or from SoEverdream himself!

[h2]Join Us[/h2]
You can join the conversation directly on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561198042104078]Steam Broadcast[/url] page, or on SoEverdream's [url=https://www.twitch.tv/soeverdream]Twitch[/url] channel. 
We hope to see you there!

[h2]Try the Game[/h2]
The HANGRY™ Demo is available now on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601510/HANGRY/]main store page[/url], and will remain available until the[b] end of Steam Next Fest[/b] on June 17th.

Don't miss this opportunity to try the game and give us your feedback!
